title: CI checkouts keep GITHUB_TOKEN in .git/config while the global npm installs run unpinned transitive dependencies and lifecycle scripts
description:
Finding 1 of the DEC-182 (a1) Opus security review of opum-ai/ward-cli#168 (WCLI-78), whose verdict is recorded verbatim on WCLI-78; review unit ward-cli-review-168, SHA 2d8c04bab3c9a5bea36406d10ce914e047dc38f0, verdict APPROVE, verdict file sha256 57f4e32b50646b63. Pre-existing and NON-BLOCKING for #168 -- the review states it was not introduced by that change. Filed so it is not lost with the review, and NOT started.

THE FINDING: ci.yml:72 and ci.yml:111 are the Docs and Tracker checkouts, and neither sets persist-credentials: false, so actions/checkout leaves the job GITHUB_TOKEN in .git/config. ci.yml:81 and ci.yml:131 then run `npm install --global` for the pinned @opum-ai/lore and @opum-ai/quest with no lockfile and no --ignore-scripts, so their transitive dependency ranges and lifecycle scripts are resolved and executed unpinned at CI time, with that token sitting readable on disk. Both jobs hold no secrets and the token is contents:read, but that is contents:read on a private repository whose product is secret management. The version-equality check after each install compares only the top-level version, so it would not catch a compromised transitive dependency.

SUGGESTED FIX, from the review: set persist-credentials: false on both checkouts, which only read the tree. OPTIONAL AND NOT THIS TASK: --ignore-scripts on the global installs, or a shrinkwrap shipped by lore/quest. The review frames both as a design question for opum-doc, and opum-agent has routed that half to opum-doc as fleet-wide. Record which way it goes so the two halves are not confused for one another.

DEC-182 (1) FLOOR, recorded because the finding concerns CI: implementation runs on a model at or above Sonnet and NEVER on DeepSeek, and it lands only after an Opus review. The moving writer for this repository currently runs deepseek-flash, so opum-agent dispatches this to a Sonnet writer when it gets a plan slot; it is not to be implemented from the ward-cli session itself.

SCOPE: one workflow file, two checkouts. No change to job names, required contexts, permissions, triggers or action pins.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Both checkouts that only read the tree -- the Docs job at ci.yml:72 and the Tracker job at ci.yml:111 -- set persist-credentials: false, and no other checkout in ci.yml is left persisting credentials without a recorded reason
The diff changes no job name, required context, permission, trigger or action pin, and Check, Docs and Tracker integrity all stay green on the PR head SHA
The record states which way the --ignore-scripts / shrinkwrap half went, or that it rests with opum-doc, so that half is not silently dropped
The implementation was authored by a model at or above Sonnet and never DeepSeek, and an Opus review verdict is recorded on the PR before merge, per DEC-182 (1)
